selection.quote: “Truck” means every motor vehicle which is used for the transportation or delivery of goods with a body built and designed for that purpose.
selection.reason: The definition denotes an extensional set of self-propelled road users distinguished by a purpose-built goods body, which the ru.* classes can carry.
